title: River Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for River — premieres Jan 15.
body:
• The trailer for River dropped October 12, 2026.
  • Releasing Jan 15.
  • RIVER "will drown you in pure terror." (TheWrap) Only in theaters January 15

The makers of River have released the official trailer, unveiled October 12, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to theaters.
